passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is located on a Norwegian island in the Arctic.
• It stores duplicate seed samples from gene banks around the world.
• In 2015, researchers withdrew seeds to rebuild a collection in Syria damaged by war.
• The permafrost around the vault helps keep the seeds frozen even if power fails.
stem: The student wants to explain how the vault served its purpose in a specific case. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?
choices: When war damaged a gene bank in Syria, researchers withdrew duplicate seeds from the Svalbard vault in 2015 to rebuild the collection.
The Svalbard Global Seed Vault, on a Norwegian island in the Arctic, stores duplicate seed samples from gene banks around the world.
The permafrost surrounding the Svalbard vault helps keep its stored seeds frozen even if the vault's power supply fails.
Gene banks around the world, including one in Syria, send duplicate seed samples to a vault on a Norwegian Arctic island.
steps: The goal has two parts: the vault's purpose (backing up gene banks) and a specific case.
Only the Syria withdrawal shows the backup being used.
The other choices describe the vault, its permafrost or its deposits without showing it serving its purpose in a case.
key: Check each part of the goal: here, both “purpose” and “specific case.”
